name: Switch!
idea: When a screen comes, yell “Switch!” and trade players with your teammate.
why: A screen only works if a defender gets stuck. If the defender next to the screen jumps out to guard the ball, nobody gets open.
tryit: Practice talking! Every time you see a screen coming, say “Screen!” and then “Switch!”, loud and clear.

frames.say: You’re on defense. {X1} guards {1}, who has the ball, and {X2} guards {2}.
{2} comes up and sets a screen on {X1}.
*Switch!* {X2} yells “Switch!” and jumps out to guard {1}. {X1} takes {2}.
{2} rolls to the basket, but {X1} goes right along. And {X2} is still in front of {1}. Nobody is open!
{1} has to dribble back out. Saying “Switch!” out loud stopped the pick and roll.
